b1-horthykorszak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Regent
b1-horthykorszak-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks who led Hungary in the 1920s and what task the country faced.
b1-horthykorszak-01.prompt: Tell the examiner what parliament made Horthy in 1920 and that there were many tasks to be solved quickly.
cues: Say that parliament made Horthy the regent in 1920
Say that many tasks had to be solved urgently
b1-horthykorszak-01.target: 1920-ban a parlament kormányzóvá választotta Horthy Miklóst. Sok sürgősen megoldandó feladat várt rá.
b1-horthykorszak-01.english: In 1920 parliament elected Miklós Horthy regent. Many tasks that had to be solved urgently awaited him.
b1-horthykorszak-01.canDo: I can understand and discuss The Regency & the Kingdom without a King in interwar Hungarian history.

b1-horthykorszak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Stabilising the Money
b1-horthykorszak-02.scenario: In a museum about the 1920s your teacher asks how Hungary's money was put in order.
b1-horthykorszak-02.prompt: Tell your teacher that the League of Nations loan helped and that the pengő appeared in 1927.
cues: Say that the situation improved thanks to the League of Nations loan
b1-horthykorszak-02.target: A Népszövetség kölcsöne révén javult a helyzet. Az új pénz, a pengő 1927-ben jött létre.
b1-horthykorszak-02.english: Thanks to the League of Nations loan the situation improved. The new money, the pengő, came into being in 1927.
b1-horthykorszak-02.canDo: I can understand and discuss Stabilization, League of Nations & Pengő in interwar Hungarian history.

b1-horthykorszak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Schools for the Farms
b1-horthykorszak-03.scenario: On a visit to Szeged a museum guide asks why Klebelsberg had so many classrooms built.
b1-horthykorszak-03.prompt: Tell the guide that Klebelsberg had classrooms built so that every farmstead child could go to school.
cues: Say who had classrooms built and how many
b1-horthykorszak-03.target: Klebelsberg ötezer tantermet építtetett azzal a céllal, hogy minden tanyasi gyermek iskolába járhasson.
b1-horthykorszak-03.english: Klebelsberg had five thousand classrooms built so that every child on the farmsteads could go to school.
b1-horthykorszak-03.canDo: I can understand and discuss Education Reform & Nobel Prize in interwar Hungarian history.

b1-horthykorszak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Titles and Addresses
b1-horthykorszak-04.scenario: In a coffeehouse exhibition your teacher asks how people addressed officials between the wars.
b1-horthykorszak-04.prompt: Tell your teacher how a minister and a general were addressed.
cues: Say how a general was addressed
Say how a minister was addressed
b1-horthykorszak-04.target: A tábornokot Méltóságos úrnak, a minisztert Kegyelmes úrnak szólították.
b1-horthykorszak-04.english: A general was addressed as Méltóságos úr, a minister as Kegyelmes úr.
b1-horthykorszak-04.canDo: I can understand and discuss Gentry, Coffeehouses & Rural Realities in interwar Hungarian history.

b1-horthykorszak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Vienna Award
b1-horthykorszak-05.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks about 1938.
b1-horthykorszak-05.prompt: Tell the examiner that the First Vienna Award was announced after the Munich agreement.
b1-horthykorszak-05.target: Miután aláírták a müncheni egyezményt, kihirdették az első bécsi döntést.
b1-horthykorszak-05.english: After the Munich agreement was signed, the First Vienna Award was announced.
b1-horthykorszak-05.canDo: I can understand and discuss Revisionism & the First Vienna Award in interwar Hungarian history.

b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Interwar Years in Review
b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of the interwar years for the citizenship interview.
b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher who became prime minister in 1921 and who won a Nobel Prize in 1937.
cues: Say who became prime minister in 1921
Say who won the Nobel Prize in 1937
b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.target: 1921-ben Bethlen István lett a miniszterelnök. 1937-ben Szent-Györgyi Albert orvosi Nobel-díjat kapott.
b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.english: In 1921 István Bethlen became prime minister. In 1937 Albert Szent-Györgyi received the Nobel Prize in Medicine.
b1-horthykorszak-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main people and events of Hungary between the wars.
